assumptions: Counts are cells per Boolean subset; the stimulated and unstimulated rows of a subject come from the same sample.
From gates: an event is positive for a marker when it lies in that child gate of the parent, so the gates decide positivity.
limits: A short chain need not have converged; COMPASS’s authors run 400,000 iterations × 8 replications.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which cytokine combinations respond to stimulation in each subject, and how polyfunctional is the response?

description: COMPASS polyfunctionality on Boolean cytokine-subset counts, from a project CSV (FlowJo export, stimulated and unstimulated rows paired by subject) or from the gating strategy's parent and child gates in every project FCS file a sample sheet names (COMPASSContainerFromGatingSet): each subject's posterior probability of response per subset, and functionality and polyfunctionality scores.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

count_filter.description: countFilterThreshold: a file whose parent holds no more events is left out (0 keeps every file). Only applies when source is gating.

count_table.description: the project count CSV. Only applies when source is table.

gating.description: the project gating strategy (Gating-ML or FlowJo workspace) applied to every file. Only applies when source is gating.

group.description: a column to group scores by; empty for none.

markers.description: comma-separated child gates of the parent to take as markers; empty for every child. Only applies when source is gating.

min_stimulated.description: drop subsets with fewer stimulated cells in all (0 keeps all). Only applies when source is table.

parent.description: the parent population whose child gates are the markers (COMPASSContainerFromGatingSet's node). Only applies when source is gating.

sample_sheet.description: the sample sheet naming each FCS file (first column) with its condition and subject columns. Only applies when source is gating.

source.description: where the subset counts come from: 'table' (a count CSV) or 'gating' (the strategy's gates in every FCS file the sample sheet names).

name: fit_flow_cytometry_compass

mean_gamma.description: subsets and, per subject, the posterior probability of response in each

scores.description: per subject: group, functionality and polyfunctionality score
